title: CSI Floorings (HK) Limited completed the acquisition of 12.11% stake in Sling Group Holdings Limited from Yen Sheng Investment Limited.
Na Qini and Li Xiaoming completed the acquisition of 22.89% stake in Sling Group Holdings Limited.
Tan Suqin a finalisé l’acquisition d’une participation de 40 % dans Sling Group Holdings Limited (SEHK:8285) auprès de Yen Sheng Investment Limited.
Tan Suqin hat den Erwerb einer 40%-Beteiligung an Sling Group Holdings Limited (SEHK:8285) von Yen Sheng Investment Limited abgeschlossen.
